title: Isandro and the Typewriter
author: Xanthe Nystrom
blurb: Mirabel Galloway, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
